title: Feedback Loops for AI Swift & Cognitive Framework
description: Structured checks for understanding and user feedback during Socratic AI dialogues.

questions.text: Did this explanation of reinforcement learning help? (yes/no)

next_steps.no: Retry with another anchor or simplify the explanation.

questions.text: Can you explain reinforcement learning in your own words?

next_steps.positive: Proceed to discuss specific RL algorithms (Q-learning, policy gradients).
next_steps.negative: Clarify the explanation with a different analogy.

questions.text: Does the explanation of Neural Architecture Search make sense? (yes/no)

next_steps.no: Try explaining with a different analogy or example.

questions.text: How would you describe Neural Architecture Search to someone else?

next_steps.positive: Discuss how NAS impacts hardware design choices.
next_steps.negative: Revisit the explanation with more concrete examples.

questions.text: Did the explanation of adaptive learning systems help you understand how they work? (yes/no)

next_steps.no: Provide another example of an adaptive system.

questions.text: Can you think of an example of an adaptive system you've used?

next_steps.positive: Explore how that system adapts to user behavior.
next_steps.negative: Discuss common adaptive systems in everyday life.

questions.text: Did the explanation of user modeling help? (yes/no)

next_steps.yes: Proceed to discuss how user models are built and maintained.
next_steps.no: Provide another example of user modeling.

questions.text: Can you think of a time when a system seemed to understand your preferences?

next_steps.positive: Discuss how the system might have modeled your behavior.
next_steps.negative: Explore common techniques in user modeling.
